page.overview:
Who is Llama?

Baby:Height: 0.935 blocks Width: 0.45 Blocks

A llama is a tamable neutral mob used to transport large shipments of items using caravans.

A trader llama is a special variant that follows wandering traders.

A llama spawns at a light level 7 or above on grass blocks in savanna plateau, savanna or windswept savanna biomes in herds of 4 llamas and in windswept hills, windswept forest, and windswept gravelly hills biomes in herds of 4 to 6 llamas, coming in four coat colors: brown, cream, white or gray. A wandering traders spawns with two leashed trader llamas. , trader llamas always spawn with a wandering trader.
